notes: visual-qa-log.json (2026-10-19) verdict=issues, FOUR medium findings, no high. All four concern a crest/flag/icon on an agenda row. Investigated each end-to-end against events.json, entities.json and the checked-in docs/logos/ assets; none is a code-fixable UI issue inside this loop's touch-set (docs/index.html, docs/css/**, docs/js/**).

Findings 1-3 (Fenerbahce→'red star', Sabah→Dortmund crest, Lille→Galatasaray crest) are ONE root cause: the HOME club is absent from the entity registry, so rowEntity()'s deliberate away-team fallback anchors the row on the AWAY club's crest. Confirmed in events.json: 'Slavia Prague at Fenerbahce' has no homeTeamEntityId (only aId=slavia-prague); 'Borussia Dortmund at Sabah FK' has only aId=borussia-dortmund; 'Galatasaray at Lille' has only aId=galatasaray. entities.json has no Fenerbahce/Sabah/Lille entry (Lille does not match 'lillestrom' — ssEntityMatchesName refuses it, no shared distinctive token). The away crest then renders.

The crests shown are CORRECT assets, not broken/unmapped ones: docs/logos/slavia-prague.png genuinely IS a red five-pointed star (SK Slavia's crest), borussia-dortmund.png is the BVB badge, galatasaray.png is the lion badge. visual-qa read them as 'wrong crest for the home club' — accurate observation, but the defect is (a) a DATA/pipeline gap (the home clubs are missing from entities.json / build-entities.js — out of scope: scripts/**, data) and (b) a DELIBERATE, test-pinned design behavior.

The away-team fallback is intentional and explicitly frozen by tests/entity-avatar.test.js:216 ('falls through to the AWAY side — for a Norwegian fan that is often the point', pinning Cluj–Arsenal → arsenal). Making rowEntity() stop borrowing a foreign away crest would break that test (npm test gate) AND override a documented design decision (the Norwegian-away-fan rationale in dashboard.js rowEntity + DESIGN.md § Entitets-avatar). That is an owner/design call, not an in-scope UI bug fix — and this PR would auto-merge to the live site, so I will not make it here.

Finding 4 (Viking–Tromsø 'Spanish flag, horizontal red/yellow/red stripes') is a FALSE POSITIVE. viking-fk IS stamped home; its asset docs/logos/viking-fk.png is the CORRECT Viking F.K. Stavanger crest (red shield, 'VIKING F.K. / STAVANGER / 1899', gold banner + white text) — looked at the actual PNG. At the 24px avatar size inside a tall, downsampled full-page screenshot, the red shield + gold band reads like red/yellow/red bands; visual-qa's own notes flag that full-page PNGs blur fine crest detail. No change warranted.

No in-scope docs/js|css|html fix exists that resolves any finding without (a) breaking a pinned test, (b) overriding a documented design decision, or (c) patching a false positive. The genuine fixes are out of scope: add the missing home-club entities + crests via build-entities / the logo seeder (findings 1-3), or an owner-weighed DESIGN.md policy change to the away-fallback. A missing fix beats a regression (or a test break) on the live site — no branch, no PR.
